caption:
A gentle reminder about what really counts

Allah tells us plainly what every soul will meet, and what real success is. Let it settle your priorities tonight, softly and without fear.

Surah Aal-i-Imraan 3:185

Save it for the day this world feels too big.

#remembrance #akhirah #realsuccess #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
alt_text: Every soul will taste death, and you will be paid your reward in full on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever is spared from the Fire and admitted into Paradise has truly won, for the life of this world is nothing but an illusory pleasure (Surah Aal-i-Imraan 3:185)
theme: gentle reminder of death / real success
